title: Degreewise ordinary pullback evaluation transition square
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme map f:X→Y, n≥0, a normalized scalar restriction comparison r₀ heterogeneously equal to the canonical identity-on-sections comparison, a coefficient-system cochain complex P on Y and a degree i, the i-component of the ordinary cochain pullback evaluation comparison commutes with the coefficient transition on X, the scalar restriction map, the finite intrinsic pullback of the coefficient transition on Y, and the inverse mate of r₀.inv.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and the paragraph preceding Lemma 4.10, printed p. 23.

proof.text: Compute on a section at (n,U). The inverse-image/evaluation map is the inverse mate of the identity direct-image evaluation comparison, the intrinsic finite map preserves the adjunction unit, and scalar restriction/direct image act by the same underlying section map. Naturality in the horizontal coefficient arrow and the canonical identity-on-sections comparison r₀ identify both composites. Extensionality gives the component equality.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and degreewise section calculation, reduced to the explicit cochain-component core.

theorem integralPullEvaluation_cochainSquare_component {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r₀ : normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr₀ : HEq r₀ (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison f
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))).symm)
    (P : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        (coefficientSequenceTransition l E X (Nat.le_succ n)) (.up ℤ)).app
        (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).f i ≫
      (((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((ordinaryPullEvaluationComplex l E f n).hom.app P)).f i =
    (((ordinaryPullEvaluationComplex l E f (n + 1)).hom.app P)).f i ≫
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
          (coefficientSequenceTransition l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)) (.up ℤ)).app P)).f i ≫
      ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        ((mateEquiv
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)))).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ r₀.inv)).natTrans (.up ℤ)).app
        (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).f i
